column1: # Kernel.DeployedBridge: Objective contract manifest. Written by `scripts/check-objective-proofs.sh proofs --pin`;
# a removed or changed row needs a line in scripts/gates/objective-contract-changes.txt.

column8: ∀ {bytes : List UInt8} {slot : Option (Minidregg.Kernel.World.Cell Minidregg.Kernel.DeployedBridge.deployedR)}, Minidregg.Kernel.DeployedBridge.decodeCell bytes = Option.some slot → Minidregg.Kernel.DeployedBridge.encodeCell slot = bytes ∨ slot = Option.none ∧ Minidregg.Kernel.DeployedBridge.retiresCell bytes = Bool.true

∀ {bytes : List UInt8} {slot : Option (Minidregg.Kernel.World.Cell Minidregg.Kernel.DeployedBridge.deployedR)}, Minidregg.Kernel.DeployedBridge.decodeCell bytes = Option.some slot → (match (Minidregg.Compiler.ResourceBirthCodec.LifecycleImage.codec Minidregg.Compiler.CanonicalCellRegistry.registry).decode bytes with | Option.some (Minidregg.Compiler.ResourceBirthCodec.LifecycleImage.live { kind := Minidregg.Compiler.CanonicalCellRegistry.Kind.objectiveActivity, payload := payload }) => Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectiveActivityCell.payloadAt payload.logical | x => Option.none) = slot.bind fun cell => (cell.storeAt Minidregg.Compiler.CanonicalCellRegistry.Kind.objectiveActivity).bind Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectiveActivityCell.payloadAt

∀ (bytes : ℕ → List UInt8) (cells : ℕ → Option (Minidregg.Kernel.World.Cell Minidregg.Kernel.DeployedBridge.deployedR)), (∀ (c : ℕ), Minidregg.Kernel.DeployedBridge.bridge.codec.decode (bytes c) = Option.some (cells c)) ↔ ∀ (c : ℕ), bytes c = Minidregg.Kernel.DeployedBridge.encodeCell (cells c) ∨ cells c = Option.none ∧ Minidregg.Kernel.DeployedBridge.retiresCell (bytes c) = Bool.true
∀ (bytes : List UInt8), Minidregg.Kernel.DeployedBridge.retiresCell bytes = Bool.true → Minidregg.Kernel.DeployedBridge.decodeCell bytes = Option.some Option.none
